rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Reverse proxy that adds authorization controls between AI agents and MCP servers. Implements delegation chain validation via RFC 8693 JWT, a tool policy engine for permanent blocks and scope checks, and behavioral anomaly detection for unusual patterns. Requires zero code changes to existing setups.
